answer: The marble index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 525 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the jade. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the opal queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. A 296 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
